note: Per-arm search limits for the sort-m9-260925 campaign. Money, request, token, reasoning and timeout caps live only in broker-config.json and are read at run time (model client timeout = broker timeout + 30 s). The development set path and SHA-256 are read at run time from frozen_manifest; holdout is never loaded. Both configs, the prompts, the seed, the frozen hashes, the evaluator hash and first-prompt.sha256 are covered by the approval hash (python -m integrations.sort_backends approval-hash).
evaluation: single pass: every candidate is scored on all 1500 frozen development states (m=9, r=1..5, 300 each) under sort-contract-2: sandboxed batches of 10, 0.2 s CPU and 1 s wall per state, 0.5 s CPU for import, kernel CPU cap per batch; no screening stage
max_requests_note: Per-arm sub-caps of broker-config.json's shared max_requests (230 at max_usd 38.4 under the conservative reservation): each arm's iterations + 5 (65/65/55/45, sum 230 <= pool), a margin for retries and SkyDiscover connectivity probes, which also count as contacts. Each arm has its own ledger, so no arm can drain another arm's share (TRACE-AUDIT-260925 defect 2).
order_note: Mirrors the lift/corr campaigns: GEPA and the sequential control first at matched iteration counts; AdaEvolve and EvoX only after GEPA shows one productive cycle. EvoX strategy evolution is off (40 < 100 iterations).
version_note: v2 after attempt 1 (live-gepa-260925-120053) produced per-state search: seed is the cyclic-sweep control, live runs are live-v2-*, ledgers broker-ledger-sort-v2.<engine>.json, finalize reads only live-v2-*. v1 sources and approval files are preserved in v1/.
